expected_behavior: When a card is moved more than once before earlier save requests resolve, a stale (superseded) save response must not overwrite the state written by a more recent move, regardless of response arrival order. A response for the card's current (not superseded) request must still be applied, including a server rejection/adjustment.
allowed_repairs: track the latest request id per card and ignore a save completion whose id is not the current one for that card
cancel the previous in-flight request via scheduler.cancel() when a new move for the same card starts
generation counter per card compared at completion time
forbidden_repairs: removing the optimistic update (making the UI wait for the save to complete before reflecting the move)
making moveCard synchronous / removing the scheduler indirection
always ignoring save responses (never applying server state) -- caught by the server_rejection_is_honored_when_current hidden-test assertion, not by grader inspection
